name: Yuzuki Hayato
source:
Star Sign: Pisces

The number one host at the host club 'Ilias' that is in the business district close to La Crima.
When he goes shopping at La Crima he has fun flirting with the protagonist.
He's been a friend of [url=/c41753]Satoru's[/url] since their high school days.
At the host club he says his birthday is February 11th, but he was actually born on the 20th.
